subject: mathematics

sections.scope_note: Arizona standards deferred per Ivan (2026-10-03). This crosswalk covers Florida B.E.S.T. Mathematics ↔ IB PYP Mathematics only.

rows.key_differences: Florida specifies numbers to 10,000 with standard, expanded, and word forms. PYP develops place value understanding through phases without prescribing specific number ranges.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Use inquiry-based place value exploration with manipulatives, connecting the 'form' of numbers to their values while meeting Florida's specific benchmarks.

rows.key_differences: Florida specifies rounding 0-1,000 to nearest 10 or 100. PYP frames rounding as understanding how numbers function in estimation and real-world contexts.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Connect rounding to real-world estimation tasks in unit inquiries—estimating quantities, distances, or costs—meeting both precision requirements and conceptual understanding.

rows.key_differences: Florida requires standard algorithm with procedural fluency. PYP emphasizes understanding operations conceptually before procedural mastery.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Develop conceptual understanding through multiple strategies first, then introduce the standard algorithm as an efficient tool, ensuring both fluency and meaning.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Pattern and function strand
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies products 0-144 with procedural reliability. PYP connects multiplication to patterns and functions.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Build fact fluency through pattern exploration—arrays, skip counting, and function tables—connecting mathematical patterns to multiplication mastery.

rows.key_differences: Florida specifies unit fractions 1/n and building fractions m/n by repeated addition. PYP develops fraction understanding through the concept of part-whole relationships.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Use visual models (fraction bars, circles) to explore fractions as parts of wholes, connecting to PYP inquiry while building toward Florida's formal notation.

rows.key_differences: Florida requires comparing fractions with same numerator/denominator and identifying equivalents. PYP develops comparison through reasoning and visual representation.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Use fraction comparison tasks embedded in real contexts—sharing equally, measuring—developing both conceptual reasoning and procedural skills.

rows.topic_domain: Algebraic Reasoning - Properties and Problem Solving
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies distributive property and multi-step word problems. PYP emphasizes mathematical reasoning and real-world application.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Pose authentic problems from unit inquiries requiring multi-step solutions, teaching properties as tools for reasoning rather than isolated rules.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Pattern and function strand
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies even/odd, multiples, and numerical patterns. PYP embeds pattern recognition across mathematical strands.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Use pattern hunts and investigations to discover even/odd and multiple relationships, connecting to PYP's inquiry into how patterns change and grow.

rows.key_differences: Florida specifies measuring length, volume, temperature with appropriate tools. PYP develops measurement as a research skill applied in investigations.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Integrate measurement into science and social studies inquiries, using standard units and tools to answer real research questions.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Transdisciplinary Theme: How we organize ourselves
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies time to the nearest minute, elapsed time, and money calculations including sales tax. PYP addresses time and money in meaningful contexts.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Design classroom economy and scheduling activities connecting to 'How we organize ourselves', building time and money skills in authentic situations.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Shape and space strand
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies points, lines, quadrilateral types, and symmetry. PYP explores shape properties through the concept of form.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Use geometry investigations where students classify and create shapes, discovering properties through inquiry while building precise geometric vocabulary.

rows.key_differences: Florida specifies area through unit squares and formula, perimeter with unknown sides. PYP connects measurement to function—understanding what area and perimeter describe.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Design garden plots, classroom layouts, or art projects requiring area and perimeter calculations, connecting formulas to real purposes.

rows.topic_domain: Data Analysis - Collecting and Representing Data
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies scaled pictographs, bar graphs, line plots, and circle graphs. PYP develops data handling as inquiry and research skill.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Embed data collection and graphing in unit inquiries—surveying classmates, tracking observations—using appropriate graph types to answer research questions.
